summary: You have submitted an exemplary preliminary report that achieved maximum marks across all criteria. Your mission rationale directly links Australian user requirements to mission parameters, supported by robust scheduling and rigorous preliminary orbital mechanics calculations.
next_steps: Advance your STK modelling to simulate full multi-pass coverage of the Great Barrier Reef over time, validating your hand-calculated swath overlap.
Refine payload sensor specifications based on your candidate orbit to confirm spatial and spectral resolution feasibility for coral bleaching detection.
Track your progress directly against the contingency triggers defined in Table 1 as you enter the detailed subsystem design phase.

criteria.C1: You achieved the Accomplished level by clearly linking mission goals and quantifiable requirements to specific Australian end-users (AIMS, GBRMPA, BoM) in the 'Mission Concept & Rationale' section, backed by appropriate literature citations.
criteria.C2: You attained top marks in the Accomplished level by integrating a robust Gantt chart (Figure 1), an insightful task narrative, a thorough risk/contingency matrix (Table 1), and well-justified information sources (Table 2).
criteria.C3: You met the Accomplished band by delivering high-quality preliminary hand calculations (Table 3), verifying orbital parameters in STK, and critically interpreting swath width against the physical geometry of the reef.
criteria.C4: You performed at the Accomplished level with professional document structure, polished and consistent formatting, clear figure and table captions, and meticulous, consistent IEEE referencing throughout the text and reference list.
